description: This file implements a SQL store for managing recaps and recap channels in the Mattermost server, including CRUD operations and JSON marshaling/unmarshaling of recap channel data.

classes.name: SqlRecapStore
classes.description: A SQL-based implementation of the RecapStore interface for managing recaps and recap channels.

methods.name: newSqlRecapStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlRecapStore, initializes query builders for recaps and recap channels.

methods.name: recapToMap
methods.description: Converts a Recap model to a map for database insertion.

methods.name: recapChannelToMap
methods.description: Converts a RecapChannel model to a map, marshaling complex fields to JSON strings.

methods.name: SaveRecap
methods.description: Saves a Recap to the database.

methods.name: GetRecapsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves paginated recaps for a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateRecapStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Recap.

methods.name: MarkRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a Recap as read by setting the ReadAt timestamp.

methods.name: DeleteRecapChannels
methods.description: Deletes all channels associated with a Recap.

methods.name: SaveRecapChannel
methods.description: Saves a RecapChannel to the database.

methods.name: GetRecapChannelsByRecapId
methods.description: Retrieves all RecapChannels associated with a Recap ID, unmarshaling JSON fields.
